Original installer control for the state-boundary regression.

The sibling file original-cold-install-0.1.0.sh is the unmodified
examples/dify-table-csv/install/cold-install.sh from product base
377fe1635c3fc0e527dbb04591776be825e9bcff.
SHA-256 86bd580527864a1526d2a884ef1b3cc7e982b828046c46829af19d422ce9510b.
Size 21154 bytes.
Those bytes are the MIT-licensed sample installer. The regression reads this
fixture, so the public package does not need another Git history. With
admission and a new state directory inside its package root, this installer
creates that directory and invokes docker. The corrected installer is
install/cold-install.sh.
